## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `zoom-meetings-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a new app

1. <!-- manual: Open the [Zoom Marketplace](https://marketplace.zoom.us/). -->
2. Select **Develop** → **Build App**.
3. Select **General App** as the app type (for user authorization with refresh tokens).
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the basic information and choose the Admin-managed option. -->

## Step 3: Configure OAuth settings

1. <!-- manual: In your app's App Credentials tab, note down the Client ID and Client Secret. -->
2. <!-- manual: Under Redirect URL for OAuth, add your application's redirect URI. -->
3. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Scopes section and add the following scopes: meetings:read, meetings:write, and user:read. -->
